chunks: My father - may God be pleased with him - narrated to me, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to me, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Muhammad ibn al-Asbaq, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Maysami - who was one of the Waqifites - saying: Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn al-Fadl al-Hashemi,

I entered upon Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both) when he had contracted a severe illness. I said to him: If God forbid, that which I ask God not to show us (i.e., your death) occurs, then to whom [do we turn]? He said: To my son Ali, and his writing is my writing, and he is my Testamentary Trustee and my successor after me.

key_terms.الْأَصْبَغِ: Al- Asbaq, a specific narrator in the chain
key_terms.الْخَشَّابِ: Al-Khashshab, a specific narrator in the chain
key_terms.الْخَلِيفَةُ: The Caliph/Successor, the one who succeeds the previous leader
key_terms.الْكِتَابُ: The writing/decrees, signifying authority and continuity of leadership
key_terms.الْمَيْثَمِيُّ: Al-Maysami, a specific narrator in the chain
key_terms.الْوَاقِفِيًّا: Waqifi, referring to those who stopped believing in the Imamate at a certain Imam
key_terms.الْوَصِيُّ: The Testamentary Trustee, the designated heir and authority

ai.seo_question: Who did Imam Musa al-Kadhim appoint as his successor?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith provides a crucial link in the chain of transmission (isnad) from the Prophet’s family to the Imams, emphasizing the continuity of authority. Imam Musa al-Kadhim’s declaration that Ali’s book is his book and he is his *waṣī* (trustee) and *khalīfah* (successor) underscores the Shia doctrine of explicit designation (*naṣṣ*) and the transfer of spiritual and administrative leadership within the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-1 (The author of the book narrated) my father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Al-Hassan ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Isa quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, on the authority of Muhammad ibn al-Asbaq, on theauthority of Ahmad ibn Al-Hassan al-Maysami - who was one of the Waqifites  quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Al-Fadhl al-Hashemi,

“I went to see Imam Musa Al-Kadhim (s) when he was seriously ill. I asked him: If God forbid something should happen to you, whom should we follow? He said, “Follow my son Ali (Imam al-Ridha). His writing is my writing. He is my Testamentary Trustee, and my successor after me.
